title: Junie Eco Mode
summary: Not every step of a coding task needs the smartest model in the world. Junie Eco Mode uses your selected model to investigate a coding task and create a plan, then hands implementation and testing to a lower-cost model. In two internal benchmarks, this approach reduced average model cost per task by 48% and 57%, […]
